title: North Sea rift basin
description: Basin edit contract for the North Sea. Phase 2 ships it with zero edit operations: the compiler validates the schema, the window, the interval references and the citations, and emits the unmodified Cao et al. (2017) polygons. Phase 8 adds the cited operations (Brent Aalenian-Bathonian, Zechstein, Kimmeridgian-Tithonian rift seaways, Palaeocene-Eocene, Devonian/Carboniferous).

window.reason: central and northern North Sea plus the southern Permian basin margin; the same window simplification.json protects from node reduction

editorial: EarthHistory modification after the references listed in this contract

references.citation: Ziegler, P. A. (ed.) 1990. Geological Atlas of Western and Central Europe, 2nd (revised) edn. Shell Internationale Petroleum Mij. / Geological Society, London, 239 pp. + 56 maps. ISBN 90-6644-125-9.
references.constrains: regional palaeogeographic map series for the Devonian to Cenozoic of western and central Europe, including the North Sea rift
references.claimOrInference: claim of the source; EarthHistory would use it as a map constraint, never traced or redistributed
references.note: no DOI; existence and edition verified bibliographically through the DOI-registered review Larminie (1992). The widely scanned Internet Archive copy is the 1982 1st edition.

references.citation: Evans, D., Graham, C., Armour, A. and Bathurst, P. (eds) 2003. The Millennium Atlas: Petroleum Geology of the Central and Northern North Sea. Geological Society of London, 389 pp. ISBN 1-86239-119-X.
references.constrains: central and northern North Sea structural and stratigraphic framework; Coward et al. (2003) tectonic evolution chapter
references.note: no book DOI; confirmed through the DOI-registered review. Chapter text was not opened.

references.citation: Helland-Hansen, W., Ashton, M., Lomo, L. and Steel, R. 1992. Advance and retreat of the Brent delta: recent contributions to the depositional model. Geological Society, London, Special Publications 61, 109-127.
references.constrains: Aalenian-Bathonian Brent delta advance and retreat in the northern North Sea

references.citation: Tucker, M. E. 1991. Sequence stratigraphy of carbonate-evaporite basins: models and application to the Upper Permian (Zechstein) of northeast England and adjoining North Sea. Journal of the Geological Society 148, 1019-1036.
references.constrains: Upper Permian Zechstein basin flooding and evaporite cycles in the southern North Sea

references.citation: EarthHistory North Sea rigid UK-block restoration contract, data/corrections/north-sea-restoration/restoration-contract.json
references.constrains: the 130-430 Ma rigid UK-block rotation the pieces inside this window are posed with; an edit to this basin must be drawn in the same restored frame
references.claimOrInference: inference: EarthHistory regional model hypothesis, not a deforming reconstruction

opSchema.geometry: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon in present-day WGS84 coordinates, entirely inside the basin window, longitude span below 180 degrees
opSchema.references: at least one entry of this contract's references[], named by sourceId; the compiler rejects an operation without one
opSchema.replaceRing: replace-ring additionally names targetRecordIndex: the Cao 2017 record whose ring the geometry replaces
opSchema.reporting: the compiler records the area added and removed per operation, per class and per interval, in the emitted catalog
